ANAT 392.course_name: Gross Anatomy of the Limbs and Trunk
ANAT 392.description: Lectures and laboratory sessions on the human gross and functional anatomy of the limbs and trunk. The course includes the study of predissected specimens. For credit only in the Department of Physical Therapy.

ANAT 393.course_name: Human Anatomy for Physical Therapy Students
ANAT 393.description: Microscopic systems anatomy and regional anatomy of the nervous system. [3-0-0] Prerequisite: Registration in Rehabilitation Sciences (RSPT) is required.

Clinics are held in cooperation with the Departments of Medicine, Orthopaedics, Surgery and Family Practice. Both terms. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
